method: forms enumerated from the registry after batch 34, not typed out
reason: Batch 34 split the swap sides and the collision demoter did its job: every side form went to review on BOTH claimants, so the antonym guard passed for the wrong reason — the forms had been switched off, not disentangled, costing the matches instead of fixing them. This removes the generic concept's claim and restores the sides on the concepts that own them.
